items.headline: PGA Tour 2028 Overhaul
items.text: The PGA Tour approved a two-tier system starting in 2028, expanding the elite Championship Series to 120 players with $20M events, plus a secondary Challenger Series with smaller purses and separate points.

items.headline: Scheffler Faces Schedule Threat
items.text: Scottie Scheffler may be unhappy as 2028 rules bar Championship Series players from Challenger events, potentially excluding him from the CJ CUP Byron Nelson which he regularly plays.
